posts.title: Menopause & Mental Health: Free Live Webinar for Clinicians

summary_en: A free 60-minute live webinar from Seasons Clinical Institute, presented by Dr. Kimberly Dolan. It introduces the impact of menopause and perimenopause on mental health: anxiety, depression, sleep disturbance, cognitive complaints and changes in sexual functioning; how hormonal fluctuations, sleep problems and psychosocial factors shape mental health; and menopause-informed assessment questions for intake and ongoing treatment. Held Friday 4 December 2026, 09:00-10:00 Central Time (23:00-24:00 Hong Kong/Macau time), fully online, free of charge, no CE credit, in English. Aimed at counselors, clinical social workers, marriage and family therapists, psychologists and graduate-level professionals.
summary_zh: Seasons Clinical Institute 免費 60 分鐘網上研討會，由 Dr. Kimberly Dolan 主講。介紹更年期與圍絕經期對心理健康的影響：焦慮、抑鬱、失眠、認知抱怨與性功能變化；講解荷爾蒙波動、睡眠問題與心理社會因素如何影響精神健康，以及更年期知情評估問題。2026 年 12 月 4 日（星期五）美中時間 9:00–10:00 舉行（香港／澳門時間同日 23:00–24:00），全程線上直播，費用全免，不設 CE 學分，全程英語。對象為輔導員、臨床社工、婚姻家庭治療師、心理學家及相關研究生。
supervision_questions: 你的個案入面，有冇中年女性個案嘅焦慮、失眠或腦霧，可能同更年期有關而未被問及？
下次做 intake 嗰陣，你會點樣自然地加入一條更年期相關評估問題？
